card.name: Farming and livestock operation terms
card.fires_on: Words that finish a farming phrase, such as lot(s) after feed, program after breeding, and operations after tomato. It also fires on livestock names in lists, in agriculture and animal-science text.

modes.label: Feedlot endings
modes.description: The word lot or lots right after feed, in cattle-farming text.

modes.label: Crop or breeding programs
modes.description: A noun such as program, operations or improvement after a crop, tree or breeding word.
modes.example: cherry breeding<< program>>. Breeder Dr. Nnado

modes.label: Livestock and farm units
modes.description: Livestock names in lists, or units like DM in yield figures, in agricultural writing.
modes.example: sheep,<< pigs>>, poultry), aquatic, and zoo animals

card.plain: It fires on the last word of farming phrases such as feedlot, breeding program or tomato operations.
